title: Luxuriant Umami Spanish Pork Jamon Iberico
description: A rich and savory Spanish dish featuring Jamon Iberico, Parmigiano-Reggiano, and render fat, grilled to perfection on a robata grill.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the pork loin with sea salt, black pepper, and thyme.
Grill the pork loin for 10 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the pork loin rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly.
In a small saucepan, melt the render fat over low heat.
Add the shaved Parmigiano-Reggiano to the saucepan and stir until melted and smooth.
Brush the melted cheese mixture onto the sliced Jamon Iberico.
Grill the Jamon Iberico for an additional 2 minutes per side, or until crispy and golden brown.
Serve the grilled Jamon Iberico with the sliced pork loin and garnish with garlic.
Drizzle any remaining cheese mixture over the top of the dish.
